dirty_source_mitigation: The exact implementation, config, protocol, and result SHA-256 values are bound below; unrelated untracked paper artifacts were not modified.
authorized_claims: In the frozen 11-case Phase0 validation matrix and 120 stored Agent responses, Full TrustAero matched every execution-boundary label with zero unsafe acceptance and zero false rejection.
Across 5,000 fixed-seed plan mutations (4,000 unsafe mutations and 1,000 valid controls), Full TrustAero observed zero unsafe acceptance, zero false rejection, and zero uncaught exception.

Hard legality-first pruning selected zero policy-infeasible candidates in each frozen policy regime, while governance-blind ranking selected an infeasible candidate in all 96 no-raw-join and all 96 strict decisions.
The complete certificate checker covered all 19 registered rejected faults; ordinary event logs covered 6/19 and lineage plus event logs covered 8/19.
Using separately frozen V3 and V4 runs, row-ordinal Lineage V4 reduced storage from about 64 to 32 bytes per edge and reduced median record-lineage latency at both 100K and 500K rows.
claim_boundaries: The planner comparison is an offline diagnostic replay over a consumed holdout, not a new independent holdout.
The mutation result applies only to the frozen mutation grammar, seed, plans, policy, and catalog; it is not a proof of absence of all validator bugs.
Certificate coverage is registered-fault coverage and PARTIAL audit evidence, not cryptographic proof of a malicious DBMS's internal execution.
The V3/V4 values come from separately frozen formal runs and are not a paired same-run comparison.
